positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Board Of Directors
positions.description:
• Organized and managed Canada’s fourth-largest Pride Festival.
• Managed teams of contractors, volunteers, and staff.
• Implemented and managed multiple event management systems(POS, web, etc).

positions.title: Technical Expert
positions.description:
• Worked closely with management to strategize greater repair efficiency and effectiveness.
• Made high-quality decisions in a fast-paced environment that had a positive impact on customers.
• Lead and mentored a team of technicians, providing support and feedback for their development.
• Quarter over quarter exceeded set expectations in areas of teamwork, innovation, and results.
• Consistently achieved exceptional customer satisfaction results while driving teamwork and innovation.
• Recognized by Market Leader for innovation in role.

positions.title: Automation Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Created test plans, test cases (manual and automated), and automation scripts.
• Worked with Development teams to provide appropriate estimates for story completions.
• Worked closely with project owners to ensure business requirements are covered for automated test cases.
• Worked closely with key stakeholders across projects to review incoming support tickets, root cause analysis of technical problems and automation requirements for regression testing.
• Coordinated with onsite and offsite resources.
• Trained and mentored team members onsite on automation concepts, frameworks and tools.
• Designed and developed automated scripts for functional and regression testing using Selenium, Ruby, Cucumber, Watir.
• Used Jira to create environment changes, release fixes, data requests.
• Automated test failures in Jenkins and improved engineering productivity.
• Used Jenkins to create and run automation jobs, and to manage failures of scripts.

positions.title: Junior Development Officer
positions.description:
• Assisted with major development projects ($2.5m+).
• Mediated conflict with trades industry.
• Assisted in the development and delivery of media plans.
• Managed major stakeholder and government presentations.
• Organized and managed large events for a National Historic Site.

positions.title: Windows Campus Leader
positions.description: • Managed communication and delivery of the Windows 7 and Windows Live story to university students and professors.

positions.title: Social Media Coordinator - Students' Union
positions.description:
• Managed all social platforms.
• Created marketing collateral using Adobe Suite.

positions.title: Visitor Services - Team Lead
positions.description: While employed with the Joggins Fossil Institute I was team lead of Visitor Services. My position entailed ensuring visitors had a positive experience at our attraction, producing staff schedules, catering/serving café customers, preparing and publishing media releases through different mediums, closing and opening of the visitor center, IT support, and various general tasks.
